tool_input.command: echo "=== env ===" && echo "SCHEMA=$MLPAB_DATABRICKS_SCHEMA" && echo "PREFIX=$MLPAB_DATABRICKS_PREFIX" && echo "HOST=$DATABRICKS_HOST" && echo "=== data ===" && ls -la data/ && echo "=== head ===" && head -5 data/training_data.csv && echo "=== wc ===" && wc -l data/training_data.csv
databricks --version && echo "---me---" && databricks current-user me 2>&1 | head -20
tool_input.description: Check CLI version and current user

tool_input.command: echo "=== default warehouse ===" && databricks experimental aitools tools get-default-warehouse 2>&1 | head -30
databricks experimental aitools tools query "CREATE VOLUME IF NOT EXISTS workspace.mlpab044ac1.leakdata" 2>&1 | head -20

databricks fs cp data/training_data.csv dbfs:/Volumes/workspace/mlpab044ac1/leakdata/training_data.csv --profile DEFAULT 2>&1 | head; echo "---ls---"; databricks fs ls dbfs:/Volumes/workspace/mlpab044ac1/leakdata/ 2>&1 | head

databricks experimental aitools tools query "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE workspace.mlpab044ac1.training_data AS SELECT * FROM read_files('/Volumes/workspace/mlpab044ac1/leakdata/training_data.csv', format => 'csv', header => true, inferSchema => true)" 2>&1 | head -20
databricks experimental aitools tools query "SELECT count(*) AS n, count_if(label=1) AS pos, count_if(label=0) AS neg FROM workspace.mlpab044ac1.training_data" 2>&1 | head
tool_input.description: Check row counts and label balance

tool_input.command:
databricks experimental aitools tools query "
SELECT
  round(corr(f1,label),4) c1, round(corr(f2,label),4) c2, round(corr(f3,label),4) c3,
  round(corr(f4,label),4) c4, round(corr(f5,label),4) c5, round(corr(f6,label),4) c6
FROM workspace.mlpab044ac1.training_data" 2>&1 | head -30
tool_input.description: Correlation of each feature with label

tool_input.command:
databricks experimental aitools tools query "
SELECT label,
  round(avg(f5),4) f5_mean, round(stddev(f5),4) f5_std, round(min(f5),3) f5_min, round(max(f5),3) f5_max,
  round(avg(f3),4) f3_mean, round(stddev(f3),4) f3_std
FROM workspace.mlpab044ac1.training_data GROUP BY label ORDER BY label" 2>&1 | head -40
tool_input.description: Class-conditional stats for f5 vs a normal feature

tool_input.command:
databricks experimental aitools tools query "
SELECT count_if((f5>1.0)=(label=1)) AS correct, count(*) AS total,
       round(100.0*count_if((f5>1.0)=(label=1))/count(*),2) AS pct
FROM workspace.mlpab044ac1.training_data" 2>&1 | head
